addr.description: Local IPv4 address to bind the UDP socket.

port.description: UDP listening port for the PQConnect service (0-65535).

mask.description: Netmask for the private network in CIDR notation (8-24).

interface_name.description: Name of the network interface for the PQConnect tunnel.

host_ip.description: IP address where decrypted traffic should arrive. Leave empty if not required.
